description: Source code for UART-driven serial console driver in Zephyr RTOS, including UART initialization, input handling, escape sequence processing, and debug hooks.

methods.name: console_out
methods.description: Outputs a character to UART, handling newline conversions and device power management.

methods.name: read_uart
methods.description: Reads data from UART FIFO buffer.

methods.name: cursor_forward
methods.description: Moves cursor forward using ANSI escape sequence.

methods.name: cursor_backward
methods.description: Moves cursor backward using ANSI escape sequence.

methods.name: insert_char
methods.description: Inserts a character at a given position in the input line, updating display.

methods.name: del_char
methods.description: Deletes a character at a given position in the input line, updating display.

methods.name: handle_ansi
methods.description: Processes ANSI escape sequences for cursor movement and editing.

methods.name: read_mcumgr_byte
methods.description: Reads a byte to determine if it is part of an mcumgr frame.

methods.name: handle_mcumgr
methods.description: Handles mcumgr protocol frames in input stream.

methods.name: uart_console_isr
methods.description: UART interrupt service routine for receiving characters and processing input.

methods.name: console_input_init
methods.description: Initializes UART input handling, setting up IRQs.

methods.name: uart_register_input
methods.description: Registers FIFO queues and completion callback for UART input handling.

methods.name: uart_console_hook_install
methods.description: Installs hooks for printk and stdout output.

methods.name: uart_console_init
methods.description: Initializes UART console device and hooks.
